subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: What proof and fix boundary are sufficient to close this canonical tool-result text-loss issue?
rationale: Current main contains partial fixes and focused helper coverage, but the remaining failure depends on long-session model-visible payload behavior that helper tests and UI-only coverage do not fully prove.

options.title: Require installed long-session proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix is validated in a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, Telegram, or equivalent run that crosses the reported context-pressure threshold and preserves tool-output text.

options.title: Accept focused helper proof after PR review
options.body: Close after the focused prompt-projection candidate lands with green helper coverage, accepting that installed-channel proof can follow in QA rather than block closure.

options.title: Split provider/media follow-ups
options.body: Close only the aggregate-truncation part after proof and keep provider/media placeholder handling in separate narrower issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Require installed long-session proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a merged fix is validated in a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, Telegram, or equivalent run that crosses the reported context-pressure threshold and preserves tool-output text.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the session-scoped prompt-projection fix and are the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether helper-level or installed-session proof is enough.
